For once in my life I knew what it was like to feel genuinely loved and cared about. She pushed me to do better. I got medicated for my depression. I got a new job. That didn't work out because jobs suck though and I was v fragile mentally.

My insomnia got worse. I got worse. I stopped talking to friends for a while. Sophie was able to break through and show me that there's a light at the end of the tunnel. That I could pull myself out from this, and that I deserved so much more.

That year I quit my job, I quit school, and I distanced myself from friends because my mental health was so awful I wasn't sure if I actually wanted to be alive. I was really truly considering it. And it upset me. It made me angry. I felt alone and neglected and abandoned.
I'm saying this because I was able to break my cycle. It was hard. It IS hard still to this day. I'm at a point in life where I have my whole future ahead of me. I can think past tomorrow.

Living with all these issues isn't easy, and im not always happy. Sometimes I think about what it'd be like to cease to exist. But I pull myself back because even though things suck a lot, I have things I wanna do, even if I'm too depressed to do them sometimes.

Until I get to a heart doctor, I'm to refrain from doing things that could make it worse. I'm essentially bedridden right now since they get pretty severe. But that's okay. I'm working around them and slowly pushing myself to be able to do normal human things.

Since I moved away from my mother, and kept contact to a minimum, my mental health has gotten better. Not enough to be off my medicine. I know because I get spotty with taking it, and the depression comes back. but I try my best to stay on track.
